```artifact
Feature: Alarms and Temperature Monitoring

  Scenario: Battery failure alarm has high priority
    Given the system is monitoring battery status
    When a battery failure is detected
    Then the battery failure alarm should have high priority

  Scenario Outline: System can sense the temperature of heating elements
    Given the system is operational
    When the temperature of the <element> is measured
    Then the system should accurately read the temperature of the <element>
    Examples:
      | element          |
      | blower motor     |
      | battery cell     |

  Scenario Outline: GUI can read temperature sensors
    Given the GUI is initialized
    When the temperature of the <sensor> is requested
    Then the GUI should display the temperature of the <sensor>
    Examples:
      | sensor                     |
      | blower motor               |
      | blower power mgmt system   |
      | battery cell               |

  Scenario Outline: GUI triggers "blower motor temperature too high" alarm
    Given the GUI is monitoring the blower motor temperature
    When the blower motor temperature exceeds the user-specified threshold of <threshold> degrees
    Then the GUI should trigger the "blower motor temperature too high" alarm
    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 100       |  # normal value
      | 150       |  # edge value
      | -10       |  # invalid value

  Scenario Outline: GUI triggers "blower power system temperature too high" alarm
    Given the GUI is monitoring the blower power system temperature
    When the blower power system temperature exceeds the user-specified threshold of <threshold> degrees
    Then the GUI should trigger the "blower power system temperature too high" alarm
    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 120       |  # normal value
      | 180       |  # edge value
      | -20       |  # invalid value

  Scenario Outline: GUI triggers "battery temperature too high" alarm
    Given the GUI is monitoring the battery temperature
    When the battery temperature exceeds the user-specified threshold of <threshold> degrees
    Then the GUI should trigger the "battery temperature too high" alarm
    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 50        |  # normal value
      | 70        |  # edge value
      | -5        |  # invalid value

  Scenario Outline: GUI automatically invokes safety action for blower power system
    Given the GUI is monitoring the blower power system temperature
    When the blower power system temperature exceeds the user-specified threshold of <threshold> degrees
    Then the GUI should automatically invoke a safety action
    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 120       |  # normal value
      | 180       |  # edge value
      | -20       |  # invalid value

  Scenario Outline: GUI automatically invokes safety action for battery
    Given the GUI is monitoring the battery temperature
    When the battery temperature exceeds the user-specified threshold of <threshold> degrees
    Then the GUI should automatically invoke a safety action
    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 50        |  # normal value
      | 70        |  # edge value
      | -5        |  # invalid value
```
